questions.stem: A geneticist is giving a presentation on recent advances in the field of genetics. During her talk, she mentions a groundbreaking Human Genome Project, which would subsequently pave the way for advances in many medical and biological fields. What was the primary intention of the project she is referring to?

options.label: C
options.text: Identify genes and sequences of base pair in DNA of human genome.

options.label: D
options.text: Introducing gene sequence into a cell to modify its behaviour.
